# AlphaPigs

> AlphaPigs builds 4,100 ft³ portable horizontal storage pigs (silos) for cement,
> fly ash, lime, barite, catalyst and dry bulk powders. Delivered to site, filled
> pneumatically, discharged on demand and moved to the next job. Buy, lease or rent.

Contact: sales@alphapigs.com · https://alphapigs.com/#quote

## What AlphaPigs offers
- [The AlphaPig — Horizontal Storage Silo (AP-4100)](https://alphapigs.com/#pigs): 4,100 ft³ portable horizontal storage pig in heavy-gauge high-tensile steel, with engineered hopper fluidization and high-capacity pneumatic transfer. Low-profile design for restricted overhead clearance.
- Materials stored: Portland cement, fly ash, slag, lime, bentonite, barite, catalysts and mineral & chemical powders.
- Programs: buy (factory-direct), lease or rent.

## Who it is for
Construction, ready-mix & concrete, oil & gas, refining & petrochem, soil stabilization, power & utilities, and chemical & industrial — plus distributors and rental/leasing companies.
